Don’t give out your personal information.
Don’t let your time on the internet get in the way of your other activities.
Never meet an online friend in person.
Tell a responsible adult immediately if you feel uncomfortable after noticing something online.
Cyberbullying (teasing or hurting others online) will not be tolerated.
Only download images or files with parent’s permission.
Don’t send images of yourself or others to people you don’t know online.
Let parents or responsible adults guide you regarding your online activities.
Pay attention to these rules in all settings.
